notes:
- More columns: 50+ details in the list view (≡ › More columns…) – photo info, video and audio details, document pages, and for artists and game developers: PSD layers and color mode, transparency, power-of-two, DDS format and mipmaps, triangles/vertices/materials of 3D models, Blender version
- Details are read only for the columns you turn on and only for the files on screen, then remembered
- Sort by any column, group by many of them
- Right-click menu settings (Settings › Right-click menu): reorder items and choose Menu / More › / Hidden for each, including your programs' entries – new programs go to More › by default
